media.caption: Skill cooldowns on a movable timeline.
Track window — toggle skills, debuffs and buffs, with filter and search.

added: CooldownBar now has its own icon in the Stellar menu — click it to open the track window.
New (experimental) "Show hidden effects" option lists internal buffs that normally have no name or icon.
Buffs and debuffs with the same name are now grouped into one row in the track window.
Very long timers now show in minutes (e.g. 16m) instead of a long seconds count.
fixed: Effect tooltips now appear in the right place when the game UI is scaled.
Buffs no longer occasionally show the wrong name or timer after you change zones.
